name: 77378 · Willis, TX
findings: ZIP 77378 (Willis) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77378 (Willis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77378 (Willis) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77378 (Willis) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
